title: Thrustbound component diagram
description: Thrustbound: a Godot game exported for the web, and a Worker that serves it to signed-in players.

components.name: Thrustbound
components.responsibility: One game: the Godot client and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Godot game
components.responsibility: The whole game: states and levels, the astronaut's physics, aliens, rocket parts and fuel, drawing, HUD and synthesised sound.

components.name: Web page
components.responsibility: The loader script, loading screen, icon and Content-Security-Policy around the exported engine.

components.name: Worker
components.responsibility: Serves the page to signed-in players, joins the engine's parts into index.wasm, and serves the other files as static assets.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in and which games: roles they hold.

relationships.description: Exported for the web by build.mjs into dist/.
Copied into dist/ next to the export.
Checks the sign-in before serving the page.
